sm_top.sm: Seven tankers have been hit in the Strait of Hormuz since November 16 amid ongoing Iranian harassment.
An Iranian strike wounded two people in Bahrain, prompting condemnation from Saudi Arabia.
Regional states condemned attacks on Bahrain and Saudi Arabia amid ongoing security threats.
Polish prosecutors and officials identified three Russian Kh-101 cruise missiles that entered Polish airspace.
Ukrainian naval drones sank the Russian corvette Merkury and hit the cargo ship MV Angara near Benghazi.
Finland reports that Russia has begun towing a cargo ship that was previously struck by drones in the Baltic Sea.
Emergency services recovered another body in the Kyiv region, bringing the death toll from attacks to ten.
Malaysia announced it respects the ICJ ruling regarding Myanmar and pledged commitment to international law in addressing the Rohingya crisis.
The Saudi-led coalition air defenses intercepted and destroyed ballistic missiles and drones launched by Houthi forces.
UKMTO reported an incident involving a tanker and military forces in the Gulf of Oman.
The Saudi-led coalition launched airstrikes on Hodeidah amid Houthi threats to Red Sea ports.
Explosions were reported on Qeshm Island amid claims of air defense activity and US strikes on an air defense site.
A ballistic missile and drone attack on Kryvyi Rih killed two people and injured multiple others.
Iran claims a US drone was taken down near the Strait of Hormuz.
A Russia-bound ship was attacked by a drone in the Gulf of Finland, with Finnish defense forces attributing the strike to Ukraine.
An explosion occurred at the Al-Hartha thermal power station in Basra, prompting urgent investigations.
Airstrikes in Kordofan caused heavy civilian casualties and displacement.
Thirty-four suspected bandits were killed during a Haitian National Police operation in Martissant.
Russia launched a massive wave of drones and missiles across Ukraine, killing at least seven people in Kyiv.
Drones targeted Russian vessels in the Baltic Sea, prompting towing operations for the damaged cargo ship Sparta II.
A Russian drone strike on a five-story building in the Kharkiv region injured 11 people, including children.
Dashcam footage captures an explosion on a street in Lviv.
RSF-allied forces claim advances in Sudan's Blue Nile State, moving closer to the state capital.
A Russian strike on a residential building in the Kyiv region left multiple people dead.
Russia launched over 150 drones at Ukraine overnight, with a majority intercepted by air defenses.
Houthi media reported 10 people killed in a Saudi attack on Yemen's port city of Hodeida.
Iran claims to have downed a US drone over the Strait of Hormuz.
Yemen's Houthis claimed responsibility for an attack on Saudi Arabia's Rabigh oil refinery.
President Zelenskyy reported that Russia launched approximately 2,700 drones and 165 missiles at Ukraine over the past week.
Israeli airstrikes and explosions were reported across southern Lebanon.
At least 15 people were killed in a heavy overnight Russian bombing attack on Kyiv.
Russian air defenses intercepted and destroyed numerous Ukrainian drones across multiple regions.
An attack in South Sudan left 24 civilians dead, including seven children.
35 Fulanis were killed in revenge attacks in Nigeria.
A US F-35 fighter jet declared an emergency over the Strait of Hormuz and diverted to a UAE base.
An armed cattle raid in Tonj East County left 87 people dead and 60 others injured.
A Russian drone attack on Ukraine left 11 people dead and prompted a major rescue operation.
Russian strikes killed 14 people in Ukraine as Moscow signaled willingness for new talks.
64 people were killed in a reprisal attack in Niger State, Nigeria.
A Russian drone attack killed 10 people in Ukraine.
